title_en: SSAFY Cohort 17 Recruitment for Hope Ladder Type I Scholarship Recipients
summary: The Korea Student Aid Foundation is recruiting trainees for Cohort 17 of the Samsung Youth SW·AI Academy (SSAFY), and interested Hope Ladder Type I (희망사다리Ⅰ유형) scholarship recipients are invited to apply. Applications must be submitted online through the official SSAFY website (http://www.ssafy.com) between 26 October and 9 November 2026. Applying is optional.
applies_to: Hope Ladder Type I (희망사다리Ⅰ유형) scholarship recipients who are interested in the programme (optional, not mandatory). Applicants must be graduates or expected graduates of a four-year university, in any major; expected graduates must be able to graduate by February 2027.

dates.what: Latest graduation date for applicants who are expected graduates

conditions: Applicants must be graduates or expected graduates of a four-year university; any major is eligible.
Expected graduates are eligible only if they can graduate by February 2027.
Applications are accepted only online through the official SSAFY website.
The training lasts one year, from January to December 2027.
Hope Ladder Type I scholarship recipients who take part will have it recognised as completion of the Fall 2026 basic job training (직무기초교육).
The information session schedule is not stated in the notice and must be checked via the information session link.
steps: Read the attached promotional material (붙임. 홍보 자료.zip); its contents were not read for this translation.
Check the information session schedule using the link http://forms.gle/fDihf6AZrGXC4qMj6.
Apply online through the official SSAFY website (http://www.ssafy.com) between 26 October and 9 November 2026.
For questions, use the contact details given in the original notice.
translation:
Recruitment for a Training Programme for Hope Ladder Type I Scholarship Recipients

The Korea Student Aid Foundation is recruiting trainees for Cohort 17 of the Samsung Youth SW·AI Academy (SSAFY) for Hope Ladder Type I (희망사다리Ⅰ유형) scholarship recipients. Interested students are invited to apply.

□ Overview of the Samsung Youth SW·AI Academy (SSAFY)

○ (Application period) Monday 26 October 2026 to Monday 9 November 2026

○ (Eligibility) Graduates or expected graduates of a four-year university (any major)
※ Expected graduates must be able to graduate by February 2027.

○ (Training period) January 2027 to December 2027 (one year)

○ (How to apply) Online application through the official SSAFY website (http://www.ssafy.com)

○ (Information session) http://forms.gle/fDihf6AZrGXC4qMj6 (schedule must be checked)

○ (Contact) The phone number and email address are given in the original notice.

○ (Benefit for scholarship recipients) Recognised as completion of the Fall 2026 basic job training (직무기초교육).

Attachment (1 file)
Attachment: Promotional material (홍보 자료.zip, 5 MB). The contents of this attachment were not read.
